$Comment: The Feastmaster, the boss of the goblin Deepworks. Its fight shows a boss bar, so the library
runs it by its encounter script and credits every player the fight counted under the script id
Dungeon_Feastmaster_Encounter; this row never counts that fight twice, since a creature a live
fight holds is never credited here.
This row is for a Feastmaster killed outside its fight (one a builder spawned on its own, with no
encounter around it): the player who lands the killing blow is credited with a boss fight,
attempted and won, with Dungeon_Feastmaster_Boss as the target.
Match.Role is the role id exactly, case ignored, so a copy under another role id never counts.
NameKey names the fight with the game's own name for the creature. The file keeps its old name so
an owner override under goblin_feastmaster still reaches it.
Switch it off with Enabled false, or from mods/ziggfreedcommon/encounter-rules.json under the key
goblin_feastmaster, and such a kill counts as a kill and nothing more.
